verdict.rationale: Rootly is an on-call product, so this story applies. The evidence says escalation policies define how Rootly notifies responders, and it mentions a truncated iOS/Android on-call app and paging in Microsoft Teams. Nothing documents push, SMS, outbound phone-call, or email paging to a responder, or per-user per-channel notification rules. Live Call Routing handles inbound calls to a team number, which is adjacent to this story and not credited.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, pages reach me over the channels I choose — push, SMS, phone call, and email — with per-channel notification rules
